An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Top examples are the first few tokens inside quoted or spoken utterances (interjections, address words, 'I wanted', 'You'); bands show weaker firing in quoted mental-health text, and the census disease-topic selectivity fits that register. Weak, broad pole, so low confidence; near misses keep the topic but drop direct speech.
